_note: Long form v2 sound profiles, from docs/longform/AUDIO-TRANSITIONS.md (measured on the references). bed_below_voice_db = how far the music bed sits under speech. Effects are files under src/skills/remotion-render/public/ (licences in public/sfx/CREDITS.md). Starting values: re-measure our own first render with output/longform-research/av_study.py and adjust.

hidden-past._from: RealLifeLore: quiet continuous bed ~24 dB under speech, cuts in speech pauses, dissolves on footage
hidden-past.transition_default: dissolve 0.6 s on footage, camera move on maps

ai-tested._from: AI Search: fast hard cuts, short silences between items, voice well clear of the bed
ai-tested.cut_rule: hard cut in speech pauses; up to 0.3 s of silence between items
ai-tested.transition_default: hard cut; blur whip into a new item

court-and-spotlight._from: SunnyV2: continuous music bed ~20 dB under the voice, picture follows the music, few hits
court-and-spotlight.cut_rule: cut on the music beat or on the highlighted word, not on pauses
court-and-spotlight.transition_default: dip to black between sections, dissolve inside

rival-lines._from: Football Made Simple: quieter narration, loud highlight moments, motion-blur whips
rival-lines.cut_rule: cut in speech pauses; whip between sections
